core_obligations: Record Noetherianity of the two henselizations (proof lines 11166-11167).

difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the depth of a Noetherian local ring equals the depth of its henselization and of its strict henselization. The proof first records that the two henselizations are Noetherian, so that depth is defined for them, and then applies the standard depth formula for a faithfully flat local map whose fibre over the closed point has the same depth, which is the situation for the henselization maps.
